headline: CSN Agrees to Sell Cement Division to Huaxin to Reduce Leverage
summary: CSN took a key step toward reducing leverage by agreeing to sell its cement arm, CSN Cimentos, to China's Huaxin after receiving a proposal above internal expectations.
why: Divestments of non-core or major operating subsidiaries allow heavily indebted industrial conglomerates to deleverage balance sheets and improve credit profiles.

impacts.name: Companhia Siderurgica Nacional
impacts.why: Asset sales aimed at debt reduction alleviate balance sheet risks and improve corporate liquidity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The strategic sale of the cement division directly addresses near-term capital structure and debt-reduction concerns for CSN.
